Event definition: Nevada, in Group 1 of Task Force 129, closed Cherbourg and fought a gun duel with the shore batteries; she was bracketed but not hit, and the group bombarded and eventually silenced the battery at Querqueville (DANFS). Event support: three source families (US Navy NHHC/DANFS, Wikipedia, Morison). Location: Offshore Cherbourg, 12,000 yards north (Fire Support Area 1, place PL4182) with a precision of 5 km.
